decision.explanation: The order O0106 with item Fresh fruit box is in 'Shipped' status and not yet delivered, so no return or refund can be processed yet. Since the item is a perishable, it is not returnable except for damage or wrong item within 48 hours after delivery, which is not applicable as it is not delivered. A coupon for waiting can be offered only if the order is late (delivered more than 5 days after promised date or undelivered and more than 5 days after promised date). Today's date is 2026-09-15 and promised delivery was 2026-09-10, so the order is late. The agent may offer one ₹100 coupon per late order. Waiting coupon requested is allowed. However, no explicit request for a coupon was confirmed by user, so no change made yet. Further action requires user confirmation.
